subject: Re: Kickoff: FNet low-cost encoder track (Q2)
body:
Dmitri — compute and staffing for the plan.

Staffing: Hyun 60%, Kaia 50%, Nikhil 40%, Jorge 30% (Jorge also carries the cloud-tpu-client tooling).

Compute: the C4 pre-training run is sized for a TPU v5 slice. We hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 384 accelerators — and Ines's team has it in the books, so the full pre-train fits in that window with roughly 20% headroom. Fine-tuning is cheap; GLUE runs go to titan-a100 best-effort.

Dependencies: the SentencePiece c4_bpe vocab model is already mirrored internally, and the Jax/Flax stack matches what Shipyard serves, so no new serving work.

One constraint: if pre-training slips past that week we're into quarterly reallocation territory, so Mar 31 env bring-up is a hard date.

Jelena
